summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe around the regulated education-finance infrastructure node. The strongest reference anchor is Nelnet because its disclosed Loan Servicing and Systems and Education Technology Services and Payments segments map directly to student-loan servicing, borrower-facing systems, tuition/payment workflows, and compliance-heavy processing. The underfollowed lane includes Maximus as a government-services contractor tied to federal student-loan servicing operations, Flywire as a higher-education payments and student-financial-services platform, and Paymentus as a broader bill-pay platform with disclosed higher-education billing, payment-plan, communications, and compliance functionality. These are research candidates only, not recommendations. Layer 1B expands the universe around the regulated servicing/payments/compliance infrastructure chokepoint. The strongest direct public-market exposures found are Nelnet and Maximus, both tied to federal student-loan servicing or systems. Flywire is adjacent via education payment plans, past-due tuition collection, student financial software, and university payment rails rather than federal loan servicing. REPAY is a speculative shadow candidate: its payment-processing, ACH, text-to-pay, IVR, and consumer bill-payment capabilities map to the node architecture, but education/student-loan customer exposure still needs verification.
